Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper presents original research with a primary focus on national-scale land use and land cover (LULC) prediction in China from 2025 to 2050 under three distinct SSP-RCP scenarios (SSP245, SSP370, SSP585). It explicitly implements spatial modeling at 500 m resolution across the entire country, uses a calibrated scenario-based framework (LUH2-PLUS-InVEST), and reports quantitative accuracy metrics (e.g., overall accuracy of 94.09%, Kappa = 0.92). Mapped LULC projections are produced and used to assess carbon storage, but LULC simulation is central to the study design—not merely an input. The work meets all core inclusion criteria and avoids all exclusion criteria: it is not global-only, not regional/local, includes multiple future scenarios with quantitative comparison, and outputs spatially explicit LULC forecasts.)
